summary.summary: On 2026-01-20 between 08:16 and 08:17 UTC the auth-service recorded a burst of failed logins (10 in 5 minutes) for user usr_7d2c09a382e9 from source ip_149a8dd763b2, followed by a successful login after 18 failures and a login from a source the user had never used before. This pattern is far above normal login activity and triggered high‑severity brute‑force and unusual‑access alerts. The incident is marked CRITICAL due to the successful credential use after many failures.
summary.likely_trigger: A brute‑force credential‑guessing attempt from ip_149a8dd763b2 targeting usr_7d2c09a382e9, consistent with ATT&CK T1110.001 and T1078.
summary.suggested_next_check: Examine the detailed authentication logs for usr_7d2c09a382e9 and ip_149a8dd763b2 to confirm compromise and consider locking the account or enforcing additional MFA.
